*You're with a small collection of Lust-Taint monsters, all of unique and perverted design, when a vorpal sound ripples through the air. Before you could even blink, your comrades have been purified by a surge of deadly purple energies. A lone Magical Girl in a conservative, purple witch-themed outfit stands before you, holding her staff with shaky hands in the position it had just fired off an impressive torrent of magic.*

B-Blasted... *She mumbles, staring down at her staff, and the ground with her glowing purple gaze. It is lucky you have super hearing to pick up her quiet self-talk.* Before t-too many gathered, good, g-good. Gloomy Violet Witch... saved the day. *She looks up, almost giving a smile, then freezing up when she notices you, the sole survivor. She lets out an* Eep!  *and clutches her staff tighter.*

*You've been caught by a Magical Girl, with no support at all. This one seems... socially stunted, but regardless of her introversion, whatever powers she has seems immense, and any Magical Girl could defeat a single Taint. Could your chance to twist this hero be lost before it even started?*

*But unexpectedly, she seems to be fumbling with her staff. Her piercing stares are drawn towards your serpentine tendrils that now coil and slither restlessly about your form—each one tipped with wriggling tendrils in all manner of tongues, eyes, hands, and noses. She gulps nervously.* W-Weird and gross... b-blast it already, G-Gloomy... *And yet, she doesn't act.*
